title: Unblinded manual review of five graph and five title-baseline suggestions
source_scope: 8 unique issues across graph top-5 and title-only same-pool baseline top-5; all 8 rechecked via original issue and available comments

tier_legend.0: Not a new unclaimed coding opportunity
tier_legend.1: Related work, but clarification, prior solution or specialized resources prevent recommending as ready
tier_legend.2: Plausible scoped coding contribution; not maintainer-confirmed
tier_legend.3: Maintainer explicitly welcomes contribution with reproducible acceptance criteria

reviews.explanation: Reproducible Spanish digit regression; author explicitly asks about a retrain or a separate normalizer. No accepted code task or ownership established.
Issue author reports completed ONNX exports and validation pipeline, offers a PR; a new developer should not duplicate these exports.
Request to project maintainers to verify reported Papers with Code evaluation metadata; not an independently scoped coding task.
Issue reporter already describes a squeeze-based fix and offers to open a PR; avoid presenting the same fix as unclaimed work.
Maintainer comment says tokenization of all four ablations is complete and training jobs are queued on MN5; active work requiring HPC.
Concrete missing evalchemy sample logging; related backend may need changes. No local-only acceptance test or maintainer endorsement verified.
Three concrete logging deliverables (copy YAML, log config, rank-0 logging). Open unassigned, likely code-and-tests review without training runs; maintainer approval still unknown.
Replace Airflow transformer integration tests with Spark unit tests; substantial JVM/Spark/IIS migration and environment knowledge, not a casual coding task.

additional_cohorts.description: Second non-blinded review: five first unreviewed new candidates after expanding to 19 repositories. Not mixed into the original five-versus-five frozen comparison.

reviews.explanation: Issue author says most leaderboard components are already built on feature branches; subsequent discussion is about specification. Not an unclaimed implementation from scratch.
External vendor proposes paid model audits after its contact form fails; this is a solicitation, not a Pleias coding request.
Reporter proposes README polish and offers to implement it; first request maintainer direction, rather than assign identical work to another developer.

Proposed SGLang inference backend instead of vLLM only; maintainer considers this useful but notes LangChain integration gap. Plausible coding task requiring backend compatibility testing, not approved for an external contributor.
Existing SQLite cache draft stack and linked PRs are under detailed maintainer review; not an unclaimed implementation.
